in_sanskrit.name: संजीव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sanjiv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sanjivana' which means 'life' or 'living'. It is believed that the name bestows upon the bearer the blessings of longevity and vitality.

in_hindi.name: संजीव
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sanjiv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sanjivana' which means 'life' or 'living'. In Hindi, the name is written as 'संजीव' and is pronounced as 'san-jiv'. It is believed that the name bestows upon the bearer the blessings of longevity and vitality.

in_marathi.name: Sanjiv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lively, full of life
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanjiv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanjiv means 'reviver of life', 'lively', 'full of life'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'san' meaning 'life' and 'jiv' meaning 'living being'.
